# gitmoap_group_sso_observed_groups (Data Source)

The group names the organization's identity provider has sent at sign-in. Every name a sign-in through the organization's own provider asserted in the last ninety days, with when it was first and last seen, in name order — what a team can be linked to. Only names are kept, never who was in a group. Whoever manages the organization's teams can read it.

The token needs `sso:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_sso_observed_groups" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The names, in name order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `first_seen_at` (String) When a sign-in first asserted it.
- `last_seen_at` (String) When a sign-in last asserted it.
- `name` (String) The group's name, exactly as the identity provider sends it — what a team links to.
